name: Ordeal of a Traveler
card_text: Once per battle, when an opponent's monster declares an attack: You can activate this effect; Your opponent chooses 1 random card in your hand and calls the card type (Monster, Spell, or Trap), and if they call it wrong, return the attacking monster to the hand.
available_set: LEGENDARY COLLECTION 3 YUGI'S WORLD MEGA PACK
